items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: Leonard Feather loved my dad, man.

ctx.x: Okay. I just wanted to tell you that I don’t know if you know that your father made the 1960 edition of Leonard Feather’s book.
Oh yeah. Leonard Feather loved my dad, man.
It mentions that he was a cab driver and studied taxidermy perhaps?
